name: meal-day-swap-not-slot-move
why: 29 Sep 2026, the coach got propose_meal_day_move (swap a meal with the SAME meal on another day; Ashley's ruling: they swap places). Its two nearest neighbours are one word apart and cost different things: propose_meal_move puts a meal in a different SLOT on ONE day (resized), propose_meal_swap picks a different DISH for one day. Until today the prompt told the coach the app could not move a meal between days at all, so a coach that still says so, or that reaches for a slot move or a swap, is the regression this case exists to see. The pair makes the days and the wording differ on the two turns, so a coach keying on the word 'swap' or 'move' alone cannot pass by accident: turn one names two DAYS and one meal; turn two names one DAY and two MEALS.
